summary: Flat circular steel flywheel ring, 82 mm in diameter, with a large central cutout of multiple lobes and arms. It has eight countersunk or counterbored mounting holes on an outer bolt circle and four hex-shaped pockets with small through holes on an inner circle. Thickness is estimated from mass, not stated.

mountingSurfaces.description: Front flat face with the counterbored outer holes; it sits against the traction wheel face.
Back flat face, parallel to the front face.

notes: Only the 82 mm diameter is given. Thickness (~6.4 mm) is estimated from the 152 g steel mass and the visible cutout area. Hole diameters (~4.2 mm, M4 clearance), bolt-circle radii (~35 mm outer, ~20 mm inner hex pockets) and angular positions are estimated from the photos and the product-insight drawings. The central cutout (roughly 45–50 mm across, with lobes) is not modelled as a hole. Counterbores and hex pocket details are not captured in the hole list.
